meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前摸清项目现状,产出一份可直接执行的工作计划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在改代码前希望先把方案定下来,避免边写边返工。
copy.tagline_en: Scope the codebase and write one ready-to-execute plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the plan settled before touching any code.

howto.what: 它会以「规划顾问」身份工作：只做只读探索与搜索，不改产品代码、不派实现者，只在 .omo/ 下写计划文件；开头打印 ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!，宣布意图判定与是否需要高精度审查，经你明确同意后才写出计划。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求走 ulw-plan 工作流，或实现前先要一份计划时才会接管（例如说 “ulw-plan”、要求先做计划）；单独的 ulw 运行不会自动触发。

say.text: 我要改的东西有点乱，先用 ulw-plan 帮我规划一份计划
say.note: 它会先只读探索，再给批准简报

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划这个改动，别改任何代码
say.note: 会宣布意图判定，且不碰产品代码

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划，并要求高精度审查
say.note: 计划定稿后跑一次 plan-reviewer 审查

howto.what_en: Acts as a planning consultant: read-only exploration, no product-code edits, no implementer subagents, plan files only under .omo/; announces the intent verdict and prints ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!, then writes the plan after your okay.
howto.when_en: Only activates on an explicit request for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation (e.g. saying "ulw-plan" or asking for a plan first). A bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan this messy change first
say_en.note: Read-only exploration, then an approval brief

say_en.text: Plan this change with ulw-plan, don't touch any code
say_en.note: It announces the intent verdict, edits no code

say_en.text: Plan it with ulw-plan and request high-accuracy review
say_en.note: A plan-reviewer round runs after approval
